search_window.basis: Authenticated prior Gaza heartbeat read from ops/watch-ledger. November 14 PST overlaps November 15 in Gaza (UTC+02:00). The newly published English WAFA report falls within the interval; the original Arabic WAFA story dates to before the preceding heartbeat, so the incident is recorded as late-recalled/newly surfaced, not falsely assigned a known event time.

findings.title: One killed and others injured in occupation shelling of a displaced persons' tent in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: People sheltering in a displaced-persons tent; one Palestinian reported killed and two injured
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian news agency; confirmed separately as a casualty report by Anadolu Agency quoting Nasser Medical Complex
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A Palestinian was killed and two others sustained injuries tonight following an Israeli airstrike that targeted a tent sheltering displaced civilians

verification.secondary_source_type: Established reporting with a medical-source attribution to Nasser Medical Complex
verification.secondary_exact_supporting_passage: An Israeli drone strike killed a Palestinian and wounded two others in southern Gaza early Sunday
verification.related_source_note: Reuters published 2026-11-14 22:31 UTC about a strike in the Mawasi area killing a Hamas Rafah brigade commander and wounding others, described as a street strike; coincidence with the WAFA/Anadolu account cannot be established, so no separate or merged casualty tally is inferred.

discovery_context.relation_to_previous_run: No matching finding recorded in the authenticated 14:41 PST heartbeat. The original Arabic report predates it, while a fresh English report and follow-up coverage surfaced after it. Event time itself not independently verified.
discovery_context.dedupe_note: Distinct from the 14 November Jabalia/Abu Sharkh strike and a death from prior al-Mawasi/Rafah wounds recorded earlier. Do not combine without event-level verification with Reuters' commander report.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded recall only; primary daily Gaza production remains authoritative.
